candidate_change: Every process that ends by a core-generating signal prints one line: name, pid, signal, exception, code, address and exit reason (PONG DEATH ...).  The five corpse slots of a boot are gone in its first 80 seconds and the exit line of v73 covers a fixed list of names, so the deaths of kbd, MessagesBlastDoorService and Freeform were never recorded.

The log capture library v247 goes into MessagesBlastDoorService too (it dies every ten seconds; opened, the Messages app waits for it and the desktop stops): its last lines and the signal, registers and frames of its death are passed on.

A read-only camera inventory (THOR CAMERA V247) runs once, thirty seconds after the root volume mounts, because /chosen now says thor-camera = 1: camera clocks, power domains, pins, I2C controller and the SPMI channels of the front camera's rails.  It writes nothing.  Not run on the phone before this image.
Every library the injected libraries load is compared with the names Apple's own binaries use.

Carried unchanged from v246: the display library (panel's size also for a display without a size of its own), the UI adapter in PosterBoard with crash capture, the Wi-Fi station's retries (5 GHz BSS, then plain 802.11g), the Wi-Fi daemon's library and the probe, the Settings diagnostic, the console capture, the firmware LUN check (v243), the retries and the record of a failed check (v242), the panic record slot (v238), the v236 GPU timing hook, the v235 witness.  No boot argument changed; the device tree gains /chosen thor-camera = 1.
